title: MPI-X: Unified Programming Model for Heterogeneous HPC Systems
problem: Current HPC systems employ heterogeneous architectures mixing CPUs and GPUs, but lack unified programming abstractions. Developers must write separate code paths or use complex acceleration frameworks, complicating portability and maintenance across diverse hardware.
motivation: Unified programming models reduce development complexity and enable transparent exploitation of heterogeneous hardware without sacrificing backward compatibility with existing MPI codebases.
method: MPI-X extends the MPI standard with high-level abstractions that transparently map operations to accelerators. It maintains full backward compatibility while providing GPU-aware collectives and memory management through a unified API.
key_novelty: Unified abstraction layer extending MPI standard to provide transparent heterogeneous hardware support with full backward compatibility
contributions: Unified MPI-based programming abstraction for heterogeneous HPC systems
Transparent GPU acceleration without code modification
Full backward compatibility with existing MPI applications
primary_theme: Unified MPI abstraction for heterogeneous HPC
